title: Classroom Scene 8 — Helping and Cleaning Up
purpose: Support social language, helping, tidying and end-of-task routines in a classroom setting.

sentenceModels: The child is giving the picture to the teacher.
The child is picking up the pencils.
The child is packing the backpack.
The child is putting the book on the shelf.

adultSupport.focus: Talk about what to do when something is on the floor, where classroom things belong, and how children can help.
starterPrompts: What is the child putting into the backpack?
Who is showing work to the teacher?
expansionPrompts: What should happen after the pencils are picked up?
Can you tell me the tidy-up story from start to finish?

visualAudit: Reviewed in Wave 3 Batch 3 automatic pass against the main teaching targets.
